sources.name: OpenRocket 23.09 Release Standalone Fat JAR
sources.provenance_limitation: Observed local byte identity; GitHub release API returns digest=null
sources.notes: Official upstream binary asset compiled with Java 17; includes core simulation engine, Barrowman aerodynamics, numerical integrators, atmosphere models, bundled javax.json parser, and packaged component presets.

sources.name: Eclipse Temurin OpenJDK 17 (HotSpot 64-Bit Server VM)
sources.configuration: Configurable via JAVA_HOME, JAVA_BIN, and JAVAC_BIN environment variables (no committed hostpaths)
sources.notes: Verified Java 17 toolchain on host; meets OpenRocket 23.09 Java 17 runtime baseline without requiring global system installation or root privileges.

sources.name: AeroTech I200W RASP Motor Profile
sources.provenance: Tripoli Motor Testing (1999) certified data, hosted on ThrustCurve.org, bundled in OpenRocket 23.09 official distribution.
sources.license: Public rocket motor data / Tripoli Motor Testing certification record

sources.name: U.S. Standard Atmosphere 1976 (NASA-TM-X-74335 / NOAA-S/T 76-1562)
sources.notes: Both RecoverySys (via src/lib/atmosphere.js) and OpenRocket 23.09 (via BasicAtmosphericConditions / ISA options) implement the standard tropospheric barometric lapse model.

sources.name: RecoverySys Public Simulation & Descent Rate APIs
sources.notes: RecoverySys implements 4th-order Runge-Kutta 1-DOF ascent integration (dt = 0.02 s) with Mach-dependent drag and Tsiolkovsky mass depletion, coupled to steady-state descent rate calculations.
